description:
Estimate what a German address is worth to buy and to rent.

Works for any address, listed or not. The estimate comes from comparable
listings around it, so `confidence` and `sample_size` say how much to trust
it - a thin sample means a wide, weakly supported band.

Returns `estimate` (point values, ranges and €/m² for price and rent) and
`confidence`. A point estimate is absent when too few comparables back it;
the €/m² band and `sample_size` still say what was found. This is a model
output, not an appraisal, and no comparable listing is reproduced in it.

features.description:
Equipment the property has. Only what it *has* - a feature
left out is treated as unknown, not as absent.

property_type.description:
A narrower type such as "reihenhaus" or "etagenwohnung";
an unknown value is refused with the list of accepted ones.

rented.description:
True values it as sold with a sitting tenant, False as sold
bezugsfrei - in Germany the same flat is worth markedly less with
one. Leave it out unless you know which it is.

rooms.description: Number of rooms (German count, e.g. 2.5). Improves the estimate.

street.description:
Street and house number, e.g. "Marienplatz 1". Required: without
it the answer would silently describe the middle of the postcode.

year_built.description: Year of construction. Improves the estimate.
